# Governance

Canonical governance model: [`GOVERNANCE.adoc`](../GOVERNANCE.adoc).
Maintainer roster and sole-maintainer workflow: [`MAINTAINERS.adoc`](../MAINTAINERS.adoc).

`0patch-lsa-sentinel` is currently a sole-maintainer project maintained by
Jonathan D.A. Jewell ([`@hyperpolymath`](https://github.com/hyperpolymath)):

- **Minor changes** (bug fixes, documentation updates, dependency updates) may
  be reviewed and merged directly by a maintainer.
- **Major changes** (new features, architectural changes, API changes) require
  issue or pull-request discussion before merge (and approval from at least two
  maintainers once co-maintainers are added).
- **Breaking changes** require advance RFC discussion and a migration guide
  (and majority maintainer approval once co-maintainers are added).

See [`GOVERNANCE.adoc`](../GOVERNANCE.adoc) and
[`MAINTAINERS.adoc`](../MAINTAINERS.adoc) for full details.
